managed.scope: frozen production Prefix vs candidate production Prefix, real native reader and mutex, host game doubles; not game FPS
managed.data_policy: Every input sample is retained. No deletion, trimming, outlier filtering, winsorization, or favorable-run selection is implemented.

statistical_methods.unit: milliseconds per render; each logged timing sample averages three complete renders
statistical_methods.median: middle value or arithmetic mean of the two middle values
statistical_methods.p95: nearest rank: sorted sample means at ceil(0.95 * n) - 1; not individual-render p95 latency
statistical_methods.iqr: Q3 minus Q1 of all sample means

fixed_gate_policy.allocation: candidate maximum per render and total warm allocations must not exceed baseline
fixed_gate_policy.checksum: all old/new checksums within each scenario equal

data.change_since_initial: batch only contiguous eligible runs; isolated cells use original single-cell path

allocation.rule: both max bytes/render and total warm sample bytes must not increase

checksum.rule: all 68 old/new sample checksums in this scenario must be identical
